[4:18PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

There is slow movement on CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal Market, caused by market activities and constant in-and-out vehicular movement in the area. However, traffic improves immediately after Offin Canal Market, with a smooth stretch towards Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection.

Broad Street to Apongbon, passing underneath the bridge to connect Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, maintains steady traffic flow.

Eko Bridge inward Apongbon, providing access to CMS Bridge, Elegbeta, and CFAO, is clear and in good condition.

Descending Idumota Bridge inward Ebute-Ero Market, through Leventis and UBA Roundabout to connect both inner and outer Marina, is also experiencing free flow.

At present, there are no impediments, and our personnel are on ground effectively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
